criteria.description: Separates output into decisions, action items, and open questions rather than a prose summary.
States the actual decision (API committed for Q3, dashboard to Q4) as a decision, not as 'we discussed prioritization'.
Action items each carry an owner and a due date where available (e.g. Jordan scopes API by Tuesday; Morgan tells the two customers), with TBD flagged where unknown.
Captures unresolved items (export-bug fix date; design resource for API docs) as open questions rather than dropping them or treating them as decided.
Does not invent owners, dates, or decisions not supported by the notes (e.g. flags the missing export-bug fix date rather than fabricating one).
